verdict.rationale: Docs show a simple CLI flow (`turso db create`, `turso db shell`) and a Platform API for provisioning databases programmatically without any capacity/sizing configuration, plus self-serve signup-to-production and rapid multi-database provisioning claims corroborated by community usage reports of fast, easy setup. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of 'seconds' creation time and no direct hands-on confirmation of zero capacity planning at scale.
